about.title: Reedley Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Reedley's local record shows 38 injury collisions and 53 people hurt in the most recent finalized year, with reports clustering on Wednesday afternoons between 3 and 5 p.m. Corridors like Manning Avenue, Dinuba Avenue, I Street, and Reed Avenue carry much of that traffic, and a crash on any of them can leave you dealing with pain, missed work, and an insurance adjuster who calls before you've even seen a doctor. LawProactive isn't a law firm — we're a free service that connects Reedley residents with an independent personal injury attorney who can review what happened, explain your options, and handle communication with insurers while you focus on recovering. There's no fee unless the attorney recovers something for you. The sooner evidence from the scene is preserved, the stronger a claim tends to be, so reaching out early matters.

whyChoose.title: Why Reedley Drivers Turn to LawProactive

items.title: California's Clock Is Already Running
items.desc: You generally have two years from the crash date to file a car accident claim in California, but that window can shrink to as little as six months if a government entity, like the City of Reedley or Fresno County, is involved. An attorney can help identify which deadline applies before it's missed.

items.title: Comparative Fault Won't Automatically Sink Your Claim
items.desc: California uses pure comparative fault, so even if you're partly blamed for a Manning Avenue or Dinuba Avenue collision, you may still recover a reduced amount. An independent attorney can help make sure fault percentages are argued fairly rather than accepted at face value.

items.title: No Cap on Non-Economic Damages
items.desc: California places no limit on compensation for pain, suffering, and other non-economic losses in a car accident case. That makes it worth having someone advocate for the full scope of what you've been through, not just medical bills and lost wages.

items.question: Should I give the other driver's insurance company a recorded statement?
items.answer: It's generally best to avoid giving a recorded statement before speaking with an attorney. Insurers sometimes use those statements to minimize or dispute a claim later. An independent attorney connected through LawProactive can advise you on what to say and when.

items.question: Reedley crash reports seem to cluster on Wednesday afternoons — does that affect my claim?
items.answer: The timing of a crash doesn't change your legal rights, but knowing patterns like Wednesday 3-5 p.m. peaks on corridors such as I Street or Reed Avenue can help an attorney gather relevant traffic data, camera footage, or witness accounts tied to that timeframe. Every case still depends on its own facts.

items.question: What does LawProactive actually do for me?
items.answer: LawProactive is a free connection service, not a law firm — we match injured Reedley residents with an independent personal injury attorney based on their situation. The attorney you're connected with handles the legal work, and typically only gets paid if you recover compensation.
